clues.redirect: There is no hay here. Read the clue again.

clues.text: Snow falls on the river. Carpenter Aldo checks every plank. Go and see the crossing he keeps so strong.
clues.redirect: This does not take you over the river. What is the clue mostly about?

clues.text: A tired goat bleats. A thirsty horse stamps. Take them both to the long wooden box at the south edge.
clues.redirect: This is not where the animals stop for a sip. Read it once more and picture the place.

redirects.landmark:well: Old Bram fills pails for the houses here. Read it once more and picture the place.
